description: Credits still needed per subject against the page requirement table for the selected state (Texas, California, New York, Florida, or Illinois). Remaining per subject is required minus earned, floored at zero. Use when the user checks remaining high school graduation credits by subject and state. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive High School Course Planner calculator.
